name: title
brief: Title card: a snowy hill at night under huge stars, the modest glass-and-chrome data-center tower on the peak with one thin smoke plume, Byteville's lit cottages far below. Big empty starry sky in the upper half for the show title.
action: Occupy SaaS ident, then the title over the snowy hill; tower bumps on kicks

name: crane-rooftops
brief: High view from the starry sky down over Byteville's snowy crooked rooftops, chimneys smoking, warm windows; the small tower glows on the hill in the far background. Open sky across the top third.
action: crane down over the rooftops; chimneys smoke

name: living-room
brief: Cosy Byteville living room at night: family asleep in armchairs, a decorated tree with NOTHING underneath it, a cat mid-stride crossing the rug left to right, an embroidered sampler frame hanging blank on the wall at upper left, the tiny tower visible on the hill through the window.
action: living room; cat already mid-stride (still)

name: rack-row
brief: Inside the tower: a long dark row of tall curly-topped server racks receding in perspective, all lights dark except one tiny blinking light; a blank horizontal LED panel strip on the nearest rack at mid height.
action: rack row; one light blinks

name: empty-rack
brief: Close on a single completely empty server rack, dust drifting in a beam of moonlight, a blank paper price tag dangling on a string from an empty shelf.
action: dust drifting in the moonbeam

name: tower-low
brief: Low angle looking up at the curly glass-and-chrome data-center tower on its snowy peak, one smoke plume, snow falling, starry sky; big smooth glass facade across the lower middle.
action: low angle tower; bumps on kicks, smoke plume

name: sam-desk
brief: From behind: Sam (normal human version: healthy skin, round eyes, short messy brown hair, plain grey crewneck, no hat, no scarf) sits at a desk facing a curved wall of glowing monitors, GPUs humming in racks on both sides.
action: Sam (cut-out layers) clicks around: the mouse darts on beats, clicks on snares, cursor follows on the big screen

name: transformation
brief: Mid-transformation: Sam turned three-quarters toward camera, villain-green creeping up his face from the neck, ears sharpening to points, a battered black top hat and long red scarf dropping onto him from above, swirling magic sparkles.
action: Sam turns 3/4, transforms into Ram; hat and scarf drop on

name: grin
brief: Extreme close-up of Ram Altman's greedy grin, eyes wide with hunger, monitor glow on his green face.
action: grin close-up push; on "memory!" he throws his head back cackling, HA!s pop

name: shop-snatch
brief: Electronics shop shelf, side view: Ram Altman's long bony green fingers snatching glowing green RAM sticks, a chip and a tiny glowing cube off the shelf left to right; blank price tags along the shelf edge; the tower visible bigger through the shop window.
action: grabs RAM, a chip and a byte off the shelf, one per stressed word

name: coding-montage
brief: Over Ram Altman's shoulder typing furiously at a glowing terminal, moon in the window on the left, morning sun in another window on the right, racks multiplying around him; a blank black terminal pane low in frame.
action: terminal glyph blocks scroll

name: howling-fans
brief: Close on a wall of big server fans spinning wildly with cartoon wind-lines and snow blowing off them, the fan grilles shaped like howling mouths.
action: three animated fans blast frosty air (blur ghosts, ice-wind lines, snow crystals, frost rims) and boost on kicks

name: window-back
brief: Back shot (callback to the window scene in We Dug Our Own Grave): from behind Ram Altman, the back of his head and shoulders big in the foreground, looking head-on out of the arched window down at Byteville; he is scheming, hands clasped behind his back.
action: back shot: Ram from behind at the window, scheming; bob and sway, evil-chuckle shoulder shake on 'down below'

name: kid-laptop
brief: Byteville kitchen at night: a kid at the table staring at a frozen old laptop with a spinning cursor, chin on hands, bored; the data-center tower (bigger, extra wings, two smokestacks) visible through the window.
action: laptop spinner turns

name: sleigh-launch
brief: The ornate sleigh stacked with server racks launching off the tower roof, swooping right to left across a starry sky, two reindeer straining, Ram Altman cracking a cable whip; a long blank banner on the sleigh's side.
action: sleigh launches off the tower roof right-to-left

name: rooftop-vacuum
brief: Sleigh flying low over Byteville roofs: streams of glowing green RAM sticks being sucked up out of the chimneys into the sleigh like a vacuum.
action: rooftop pass; RAM sucked out of chimneys

name: wink
brief: Close on Ram Altman at the sleigh's reins, winking at the viewer, scarf streaming, a curling vapour trail behind the sleigh.
action: sky streams past the sleigh; Ram snaps the reins on every beat, whip-crack on snares, winks on "wink"

name: empty-tree
brief: A Byteville family (dad, mum, two kids) staring sadly at the empty space under their tree, a blank gift tag hanging from a branch at the middle; the tower glows through the window.
action: family (cut-out layers) sobs on alternating beats, tears fall and splash, blank tag drawn 2x for a big lyric; slow push-in

name: shop-window
brief: Electronics shop window from the snowy street: a single RAM stick on a velvet cushion with a huge blank price tag; townsfolk with jaws dropped reflected in the glass.
action: shoppers bob up to the window, recoil in shock as the red price sticker flips higher on each beat

name: tower-cloud
brief: The data-center tower, now bigger with extra floors and side wings, its top piercing a glowing cyan cloud bank, smoke from two stacks.
action: tower in the cyan cloud; bumps, smoke

name: token-mountain
brief: Ram Altman on top of a mountain of gold tokens with circuit patterns, flinging handfuls into the air, coins raining down.
action: shopping spree: sleigh pass over the shop street pouring coins on each beat; shop signs flip to SOLD

name: cackle
brief: Low-angle wide shot of Ram Altman cackling with his head thrown back on the tower's balcony, scarf flying, Byteville below.
action: hovering sleigh over the sold-out street; Ram leans back cackling on snares, HA!s pop

name: crane-roof
brief: Exterior: the tower humming and glowing bright at night, a string of marquee bulbs running around its upper floors, smoke and an occasional spark.
action: tower humming bright; marquee bulbs chase

name: vault
brief: Ram Altman slamming a giant round vault door on a wall of glowing green RAM shelves; the door's big smooth face takes the middle of the frame.
action: round vault door rolls across the doorway; Ram on its right shoves it on beats, kicks knock it back; RAM spills out of the gap and piles on the floor

name: grab-vram
brief: Side view: Ram Altman's two long arms reaching and yanking a graphics card and a glass cookie-jar full of glowing cache chips off a shelf.
action: generic electronics store: Ram sweeps RAM boxes off the shelf into a teetering armful; a girl behind him reaches and is left at a bare shelf

name: stash
brief: Ram Altman cramming SSD drives into a bulging sack, then caught mid-shove looking straight at the viewer with a guilty squint, the sack half hidden behind his back.
action: shoves SSDs in the sack; freeze and squint at camera on 'umm, stash'

name: whiteboard
brief: Ram Altman pointing a long finger at a whiteboard with a hand-drawn chart line rocketing up and to the right (no numbers or words), top of the board left clear.
action: jabs at the chart on beats

name: banner
brief: The sprawling top-heavy mega-tower with fans everywhere, thick smoke and spark showers, a giant blank vertical banner unrolling down its face; tiny Ram Altman on a podium at its base.
action: mega-tower banner; bumps, smoke and sparks

name: receipt
brief: A receipt printer spitting an endless blank paper invoice that tumbles down a staircase, out the tower door and across the snow towards Byteville.
action: receipt paper scrolls down the stairs

name: elves-jpg
brief: Four little data-center elves in green hoodies with headsets in a row, a giant mechanical press stamping down on them, the right half of the image showing them squashed into one blocky, smeared, low-quality picture.
action: top-down workshop: 4 lanes of 4 same-job elves; a piston per lane slams them into one four-armed elf doing all four jobs

name: reindeer-buffering
brief: Two reindeer frozen mid-leap in the night sky pulling the sleigh, with the mega-tower smoking in the background.
action: team freezes on 'buffering', pixelates, spinner

name: star
brief: Byteville's big town-square Christmas tree from below, camera rising to the shining gold star at the top, with a little blank velvet ribbon tied under the star; the mega-tower on the hill behind.
action: star spins to its pixelated back, falls, shatters with the glass break

name: register
brief: An ornate old brass cash register with its drawer springing open, a row of blank display tiles across its top.
action: typewriter-register: keys clack per letter of each word, $ flags pop up on the tiles, dollar signs float up, DING! on "year!"

name: sleigh-pass
brief: Low angle: the sleigh passing left to right under a huge full moon, loot spilling, the grotesquely huge belching tower filling the sky behind.
action: left-to-right pass under the moon

name: clam-model
brief: Ram Altman shovelling RAM into the hopper of a giant brass-and-glass machine shaped like a big dopey clam with goofy eyes.
action: the whole golden machine-creature snaps shut on every beat (squash) and springs open (stretch); bill crumbs puff out

name: carolers
brief: Byteville carolers in scarves on a snowy doorstep, mouths open, a long blank paper scroll unfurling out of a speaker box on the door.
action: carolers (cut-out layers) sway on the bar, bob on the beat, open wide on every sung word; music notes float up

name: facts-scroll
brief: Close on a long blank parchment scroll held open by mittens, with a blank sticky note slapped on its corner.
action: facts scroll

name: gpu-throne
brief: Ram Altman lounging on a towering throne built from stacked graphics cards with glowing fans, seen from a low angle.
action: throne of GPUs low angle; the whole picture bumps on every beat

name: squash
brief: Ram Altman bringing down a giant rubber stamp on tiny townsfolk (a shopkeeper, kids with a garage workbench) scattering; a blank envelope fluttering in the foreground.
action: Ram stamps every two beats; 14 townsfolk run about in panic, scatter from each slam, three get flattened and pop back

name: christmas-morning
brief: Christmas morning: the family running downstairs left to right in pyjamas, sunlight through the window where the monstrous tower smokes on the hill.
action: family runs downstairs left to right

name: overhead-floor
brief: Straight-down overhead view of the bare floor under the tree, four sad faces peering down from the edges of frame.
action: overhead of the bare floor

name: cookies
brief: Close on a plate holding only cookie crumbs and one bitten cookie, next to a blank card propped up against a glass of milk.
action: cookie crumbs

name: tiny-heart
brief: Dark, dramatic: Ram Altman alone in his vault, an x-ray view of his chest showing a heart that is just two tiny green memory chips.
action: clutches chest as the tiny-DIMM heart glows

name: kernel-panic
brief: A wall of monitors behind Ram Altman all flashing an alarming blank red-and-black panic screen, Ram clutching his hat.
action: panic screens flash on snares

name: racks-stall
brief: Long server hall with the lights going out row by row toward the camera, the nearest racks still lit.
action: lights go out row by row toward camera

name: sleigh-sag
brief: Wide: the sleigh grossly overloaded with the whole town's memory, sagging, reindeer straining to lift it off the tower roof, the tower sparking and cracked.
action: overloaded sleigh sags and struggles to lift

name: sleigh-tips
brief: Dutch-angle tracking shot of the sleigh tipping and sputtering in the clouds, loot sliding, Ram Altman's panicked face.
action: sleigh tips and sputters

name: crash
brief: The sleigh nose-diving into the snowy hillside below the tower, a huge fountain of glowing green RAM sticks and sparkles bursting over Byteville.
action: nose-dive crash; RAM fountain over Byteville

name: march
brief: Townsfolk and elves marching up the snowy hill left to right holding lanterns, the leaning, smoking, sparking peak-size tower ahead of them.
action: march up the hill with lanterns

name: paywall
brief: Elves tearing apart a velvet rope barrier with a blank hanging sign, tokens spilling free.
action: elves bob and sway; rope tug-of-war snaps on "un-paywalled", tokens burst

name: patch
brief: An elf on a ladder slapping a giant band-aid over a cracked, sparking server.
action: watching elves bob along; the ladder elf slaps the band-aid on "patched" with sparks

name: build-open
brief: Townsfolk and elves building a cheerful tower together out of transparent glass boxes in the town square, the smoking giant tower in the distance.
action: bucket brigade: each beat the next carrier hoists a glowing box up the line; everyone bobs; tower bumps

name: balloon-pop
brief: A giant gold balloon bursting over the town square in a shower of confetti, townsfolk cheering.
action: townsfolk watch the valuation balloon wobble; it bursts on "popped" and everyone jumps

name: town-chorus
brief: Wide crane over the whole town singing in the snowy square, elf choir on the bandstand, the tower looming.
action: whole town sings; tower bumps

name: gifts
brief: Gifts landing under trees in cosy Byteville homes: a game console, a laptop, a ham-radio set with a big antenna, wrapped presents.
action: gifts drop under trees

name: give-back
brief: The hill around the tower: wind turbines spinning, a water tower filling, green fields pushing through the snow.
action: water pours into the tank (streams, ripples, splashes); town windows flicker and black out one by one; tower bumps

name: girl-asks
brief: Over Ram Altman's shoulder down to the little Byteville girl on the step: too-big knit hat, gap-tooth smile, mittens, holding a cardboard science-fair trifold. Ram wears a fake-friendly smile.
action: girl asks (lip-sync); Ram's fake smile

name: hi-five
brief: Profile two-shot on the doorstep: Ram Altman crouching to the girl's level, both raising hands for a high five, a sparkle between their palms, space above them.
action: hi-five; Ram says subscribe (lip-sync)

name: pull-back
brief: Exterior wide of the giant smoking, sparking tower at its peak size, a small figure waving at its door, the girl walking away down the hill.
action: pull back from the waving figure

name: elves-ship
brief: An elf assembly line packing boxes with blank labels onto a conveyor running out of the tower.
action: elves pack boxes on the beat

name: marquee
brief: An old-timey theatre on Byteville's main street at night, its big blank lightbulb marquee glowing, snow falling, the tower on the hill behind.
action: marquee bulbs chase; tower behind

name: stage-bow
brief: A spotlight on Ram Altman bowing on a little stage with red curtains.
action: bow with hat tip in the spotlight

name: scrooge-card
brief: Extreme close-up of Ram Altman's smug face holding up a blank white card beside his chin.
action: Ebenezer Scrooge smash cut; after "Scrooge!" Ram bursts out laughing, HA HA HA

name: boom
brief: Exterior wide of the gigantic data-center tower mid-collapse, imploding in on itself, smoke sucking inward, over a quiet snowy hill with Byteville's windows glowing warm below.
action: victorious ending: the tower swells, glowing red and shaking, then explodes; RAM rains on Byteville and the townsfolk run in cheering to catch it
